Name: Console Chat
Author: Sonozuki
Description:
A simple mod that logs chat in the console and allows you to speak from the console.

[size=4]Command[/size]:
say <message>

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Extra info[/size][list]
[*]To uninstall delete Stardew Valley/Mods/ConsoleChat.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: ConsoleChat for SMAPI V2.9 and above
